goal: Generate a high-density explanation slide suitable for open class handouts, WeChat long images, and internal sharing materials, helping readers establish a complete cognitive framework for large model evaluation systems in one image.

style.format: Single page multi-column infographic + central anchor point illustration (ponchi-e style soft block surface)
style.blend: Irasutoya soft and warm illustration +霞关 style Slides high information density and numbering order

title_section.main_title: How to understand a large model evaluation report.
title_section.subtitle: From ranking and benchmarks to reproducibility, a single diagram sets up the reading framework.

centerpiece.description: Center of the screen slightly above, an open laptop screen displays a simplified line chart and bar graph, next to it stands a cartoon character holding a magnifying glass, symbolizing 'reading the report with questions'; three small labels around connected by fine lines: MMLU, human review, long context

sections.count: Saturated and glaring background colors impact text recognition.
items: What to read: Does the task domain cover the scenarios you care about (math, code, multi-turn dialogue, multi-modal)
How to interpret scores: main indicators and secondary rankings, distinguishing average rankings from strengths in individual topics.
Prevent misunderstanding: open book / closed book, whether it can connect to the internet, whether tools can be used, multiple versions of the same model need to verify submission numbers
Reproducible: Random seed, temperature, system prompt, evaluation window, and submission date must be recorded together
How to use: Cross-validate list conclusions with internal business assessments, manual checks, and online A/B results.
sections.section_block_style: Each section consists of a small illustration + title + 2-3 sentences of explanation, with a restrained tone that is not sentimental

annotations.rule: Annotation lines cannot intersect with the central subject, with leads pointing from the block edge to the outer edge of the main image.

footer.summary: Core: The list is the starting point; business alignment, reproducibility, and manual verification are the support for conclusions.

must_keep: High information density, but reading order is clear from title → center → columns
The central subject acts as a visual anchor, surrounded by five segmented columns or symmetrically arranged left and right.
The style of the illustration matches the tone of the descriptive text, without showing realistic photo style.
The color palette is strictly ≤ 3 colors, with accent colors used only for subtitles and key numbers
avoid: The font size of paragraphs and the hierarchy of headings are confusing
Illustration that is too detailed and realistic destroys the Irasutoya feel
Text fills to the edge with no white space.
Mixed layout with Chinese, English, and Japanese text
